info.name: NCBI Entrez E-utilities History Links API

params.name: db
params.description: Database to search for linked records. Omit when cmd is llinks or llinkslib.

params.name: linkname
params.description: Name of a specific link to retrieve (e.g., pubmed_pubmed, pubmed_pmc).

params.name: term
params.description: Entrez query to filter linked UIDs.

params.name: holding
params.description: Name of a LinkOut provider to restrict LinkOut links.

params.name: datetype
params.description: Type of date to limit the link results.

params.name: reldate
params.description: Limit results to items published in the last n days.

params.name: mindate
params.description: Minimum date for date range filter.

params.name: maxdate
params.description: Maximum date for date range filter.

params.name: WebEnv
params.description: Web environment string from a previous call.

params.name: query_key
params.description: Integer query key from a previous call.

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

items.docs: Returns UIDs linked to an input set of UIDs in either the same database or a different Entrez database. Also returns LinkOut URLs for non-Entrez external resources, and checks for the existence of links in either direction.
